name: smwgraphics-smw-just-keef-edition-mario-and-luigi
title: SMW Just Keef Edition - Mario and Luigi
description:
I redesigned Mario and Luigi for my hack and thought others might like to used them. Mario does not have a lot of changes but Luigi has many many many. I used the SMAS Luigi and fixed a lot of the stuff they got lazy with. Why did Luigi only have 1 foot? Whatever.

Use with the Separate Luigi Graphics patch. Hope you enjoy.
